label: Faqs

value.question: How do I request an appointment?
value.answer: Message VueSmile Dental Clinic on Facebook with your preferred date and time. The clinic will reply to confirm your schedule. You can prepare a message using the appointment section below.

value.question: What if I’m not sure which service I need?
value.answer: Choose “Consultation — help me choose” when preparing your message. Tell the clinic you would like a consultation, and discuss your questions with the dentist during your visit.

value.question: What should I bring to my first visit?
value.answer: Ask the clinic when you confirm your appointment. If you have previous dental records or questions about your visit, mention them in your message so the clinic can guide you.

value.question: How can I ask about treatment fees?
value.answer: Send the clinic a message about the service you are interested in. A consultation may be needed before the dentist can provide a treatment plan and fee estimate.

value.question: Where is the clinic located?
value.answer: You can find VueSmile Dental Clinic at Golden Meadows, Gabi Road, Cordova, Cebu, 6017. Use the directions link below, or message the clinic for help finding the entrance.
